Anne is nice. Anne is young. Dave is cold. Dave is smart. Dave is white. Fiona is nice. Fiona is not red. Fiona is young. Gary is cold. Gary is red. If someone is smart then they are green. If someone is green then they are nice. Nice people are young. If someone is white then they are young. If someone is cold then they are white. If someone is green and smart then they are white. All young, red people are smart. If Fiona is red then Fiona is green. If Anne is smart then Anne is not green.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Gary is not smart.

Red(Gary, True) ::: Gary is red.

Smart($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: If someone is smart then they are green.
Green($x, True) >>> Nice($x, True) ::: If someone is green then they are nice.

White($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: If someone is white then they are young.
Cold($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: If someone is cold then they are white.
Green($x, True) && Smart($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: If someone is green and smart then they are white.
Young($x, True) && Red($x, True) >>> Smart($x, True) ::: All young, red people are smart.
Red(Fiona, True) >>> Green(Fiona, True) ::: If Fiona is red then Fiona is green.
Smart(Anne, True) >>> Green(Anne, False) ::: If Anne is smart then Anne is not green.

Query:
Smart(Gary, False) ::: Gary is not smart.
